$comment: Calls to interpolate, judged by both editors alike: a Kotlin template in the format, which Kotlin fills before interpolate sees it (interpolate-template); holes miscounted against the values (interpolate-holes); each %s hole judged by where it lands and what the value is (unsafe-interpolation); and the format read as HTML. The format is the one of kotlin.json.

issues.message: interpolate throws here unless tag is Trusted(...): it lands in the markup's own structure, a tag name, an attribute name or an unquoted value. Build that part of the markup from literals, or quote the attribute value; wrap markup you built yourself in Trusted(...).
